verdict.rationale: The OCR docs say `include_blocks` returns a per-page blocks array with structural block labels, paragraph-level bounding boxes and content in reading order. Header and footer content is split into dedicated fields, and community users praise the PDF-to-markdown output, which together cover the core of preserving structure for downstream LLMs. One hands-on report of a whole page being returned as a single image shows structure can occasionally be lost, but that is an isolated failure rather than a contradiction of the documented capability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of heading levels and section nesting (the label taxonomy is not described), independent hands-on corroboration that heading and section hierarchy is reliably preserved.
